Container.Name: ChannelFlow
Container.Overview: ChannelFlow-Server — simulated live TV (channels, EPG, commercials, AI lineups, native WeatherStar, and news). On first launch the Web UI wizard sets PostgreSQL and the admin login. Add library connections and path remaps in the UI, then paste this server's M3U and XMLTV into Jellyfin Live TV.
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL server ChannelFlow can reach (entered in the first-launch wizard). The same media files Jellyfin uses, mounted at /media.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: ChannelFlow Web UI, admin API, M3U/XMLTV, and live streams

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Config, logos, logs, and caches. The setup wizard saves Postgres as database.json here. Logs are logs/channelflow-YYYYMMDD.log.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Same library share Jellyfin uses. Remap Jellyfin prefixes to /media on Library → Connections.

Config.Name: Intel GPU
Config.Description: Pass /dev/dri for Intel VAAPI / Quick Sync. Encode settings are on the Transcode tab.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: IANA time zone for the container clock, log timestamps, and midnight jobs. Match General → schedule time zone.
